subject: Kickoff: fair submodular selection for retrieval slates
body:
Team — kicking off the fair submodular selection track for graphs-retrieval.

The research gives us streaming submodular maximization under a matroid constraint with fairness guarantees — exactly the machinery we need for retrieval slates that must balance coverage against per-group quotas. Product framing: a candidate-selection library the retrieval stack can call, with fairness constraints declared per surface.

Plan for the window: (1) port the C++17 reference into our build by Feb 27; (2) reproduce the maximum-coverage experiment on the Pokec social graph, including the attribute-extraction preprocessing, by end of March; (3) benchmark against our current re-ranker on internal retrieval logs in April; (4) integration proposal plus launch-review pre-read by May 25.

Freya owns algorithms, Umar experiments, Fumiko the internal-logs benchmark. Ivo will cover staffing and budget.

Anders
